sentences.en: I want to stand next to these soon-to-be-very-rich people.
sentences.zh: 我想站在这些即将变得非常富有的人身边。

sentences.en: Earlier this month, in the Oval Office, surrounded by kids,
sentences.zh: 本月早些时候，在椭圆形办公室，孩子们环绕着，

sentences.en: President Trump rang a ceremonial bell to open the stock market.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统敲响了仪式钟，开启了股市交易。

sentences.en: So today, with the ringing of the opening bell for the stock market, those accounts will now begin to grow right along with our booming economy.
sentences.zh: 所以今天，随着股市开盘钟声的敲响，这些账户将随着我们蓬勃发展的经济一起开始增长。

sentences.en: He announced the start of so-called Trump accounts, a new investment device that could eventually address the nation's wealth gap.
sentences.zh: 他宣布启动所谓的“特朗普账户”，这是一种新的投资工具，最终可能解决国家的贫富差距问题。

sentences.en: We're giving this money to children so they can have a good life.
sentences.zh: 我们把这笔钱给孩子们，这样他们就能过上好日子。

sentences.en: Very early on, they can have a good life.
sentences.zh: 在很小的时候，他们就能过上好日子。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Claire Kane-Miller on how these accounts actually work, why they have bipartisan support, and why, even weeks after their launch,
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事克莱尔·凯恩-米勒将介绍这些账户的实际运作方式、它们为何获得两党支持，以及为什么即使在推出几周后，

sentences.en: so many Americans have yet to sign up for free money.
sentences.zh: 仍有许多美国人尚未注册领取这笔免费资金。

sentences.en: It's Friday, July 24th.
sentences.zh: 今天是7月24日，星期五。

sentences.en: Hello, Claire.
sentences.zh: 你好，克莱尔。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: I'm so glad that you could join us today, because when we talk about Trump's signature piece of legislation of this second term, what he calls the big, beautiful bill,
sentences.zh: 很高兴你能参加今天的节目，因为当我们谈论特朗普第二任期的标志性立法，也就是他所说的“宏大而美丽的法案”时，

sentences.en: we typically talk about tax cuts, we talk about ICE funding, hiring Border Patrol agents, but tucked into this enormous piece of legislation
sentences.zh: 我们通常谈论的是减税、ICE（移民及海关执法局）拨款、雇佣边境巡逻人员，但在这项庞大的立法中，

sentences.en: is an initiative that I know you have been focusing on, and that's Trump accounts.
sentences.zh: 包含了一项我知道你一直关注的倡议，那就是“特朗普账户”。

sentences.en: Claire, as someone who covers families and the public policy that affects them, can you tell me where this idea came from,
sentences.zh: 克莱尔，作为一名报道家庭及其相关公共政策的记者，你能告诉我这个想法是从哪里来的吗？

sentences.en: this idea of Trump-branded investment accounts for children?
sentences.zh: 这个以特朗普命名的儿童投资账户的想法？

sentences.en: Where do we start here?
sentences.zh: 我们从哪里开始说起呢？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: So the general idea is that babies and children can start investing in the stock market, and babies born during Trump's second term get $1,000 from the federal government to do so.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，这个想法是婴儿和儿童可以开始投资股市，而在特朗普第二任期内出生的婴儿将从联邦政府获得1000美元用于投资。

sentences.en: The idea is actually decades old.
sentences.zh: 这个想法其实已经有几十年历史了。

sentences.en: It's trying to address the fact that many Americans aren't in the stock market at all, and so they're missing out on that wealth building, and it contributes to a wealth gap
sentences.zh: 它试图解决许多美国人根本不参与股市的事实，因此他们错过了财富积累的机会，这导致了贫富差距，

sentences.en: between, you know, kids from poor and rich families, kids from Black and Latino families, and white families.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在贫困家庭和富裕家庭的孩子之间，在黑人和拉丁裔家庭的孩子与白人家庭的孩子之间。

sentences.en: And so the general idea is try to shrink that to give everyone a chance to invest, starting when they're really young, so that they have more time
sentences.zh: 所以总的想法是试图缩小这种差距，让每个人都有机会投资，从他们很小的时候就开始，这样他们就有更多的时间

sentences.en: for that investment to compound and grow.
sentences.zh: 让投资复利增长。

sentences.en: And this is essentially free money.
sentences.zh: 这本质上是免费的钱。

sentences.en: People don't need to pay for this.
sentences.zh: 人们不需要为此付费。

sentences.en: This is just money that's out there that they can take advantage of.
sentences.zh: 这只是现成的钱，他们可以利用。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: All they need to do is open a Trump account.
sentences.zh: 他们所要做的就是开一个特朗普账户。

sentences.en: You mentioned that there was also a history behind this kind of idea even before Trump announced it as well.
sentences.zh: 你提到在特朗普宣布之前，这种想法背后也有历史。

sentences.en: Can you take me through a little bit of that history?
sentences.zh: 你能带我了解一下那段历史吗？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: So this idea started several decades ago, and there are a few states that have experimented with it.
sentences.zh: 这个想法始于几十年前，有几个州已经对此进行了试验。

sentences.en: Two examples are Oklahoma, where some kids, as part of an experiment, have received money to invest in the stock market,
sentences.zh: 两个例子是俄克拉荷马州，那里的一些孩子作为实验的一部分，收到了投资股市的资金；

sentences.en: and Maine, where a philanthropist has pledged to give every baby born a certain amount of money to invest in the stock market.
sentences.zh: 还有缅因州，一位慈善家承诺给每个出生的婴儿一定数额的钱用于投资股市。

sentences.en: Some cities have also done this, and they're mostly going into college savings accounts, like 529s.
sentences.zh: 一些城市也这样做过，而且它们大多进入了大学储蓄账户，比如529计划。

sentences.en: And the idea, interestingly to me, has bipartisan support.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，这个想法得到了两党的支持。

sentences.en: Both Democrats and Republicans have supported the general idea.
sentences.zh: 民主党人和共和党人都支持这个大方向。

sentences.en: They might disagree on some of the specifics of how the policy works.
sentences.zh: 他们可能在政策运作的具体细节上存在分歧。

sentences.en: But the idea of allowing children to start investing in the stock market when they're young appeals to both parties, and it's one that people have been
sentences.zh: 但让孩子们在年轻时就开始投资股市的想法吸引了两个党派，这是人们几十年来一直

sentences.en: trying to get in to the mainstream for decades now.
sentences.zh: 试图将其推向主流的想法。

sentences.en: That's interesting.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣。

sentences.en: More recently, there were two bills, one from the right and one from the left, trying to start these accounts.
sentences.zh: 最近，有两项法案，一项来自右翼，一项来自左翼，试图启动这些账户。

sentences.en: One was from Cory Booker, a Democrat who proposed the idea of baby bonds, where all babies would get a certain amount, and then babies born in low-income families
sentences.zh: 一项来自民主党人科里·布克，他提出了“婴儿债券”的想法，即所有婴儿都会获得一定金额，然后低收入家庭出生的婴儿

sentences.en: would get even more to try to close that wealth gap.
sentences.zh: 会获得更多，以试图缩小贫富差距。

sentences.en: And then another idea came from someone on the opposite side of the aisle,
sentences.zh: 另一个想法来自对立阵营的某个人，

sentences.en: Ted Cruz, who proposed an idea that looks very much like the version of Trump accounts that we now have in this bill.
sentences.zh: 泰德·克鲁兹，他提出的想法看起来非常像我们现在法案中的“特朗普账户”版本。

sentences.en: Ted Cruz and Cory Booker, two people not exactly always meeting and agreeing on the same policy.
sentences.zh: 泰德·克鲁兹和科里·布克，这两个人并不总是能在同一政策上达成一致。

sentences.en: But here, we have this rare case of bipartisanship.
sentences.zh: 但在这里，我们看到了这种罕见的两党合作案例。

sentences.en: Right, and I think it reflects something that I've been observing covering family policy, which is that politicians in general talk about the importance of family.
sentences.zh: 没错，我认为这反映了我报道家庭政策时观察到的一些现象，即政客们通常会谈论家庭的重要性。

sentences.en: They talk a lot about family values.
sentences.zh: 他们谈论了很多家庭价值观。

sentences.en: But in general, Democrats have been more willing to invest government resources in family policies, things like paid family leave or universal child care
sentences.zh: 但总的来说，民主党人更愿意在家庭政策上投入政府资源，比如带薪家庭假或全民托儿服务，

sentences.en: or an expanded child tax credit.
sentences.zh: 或者扩大儿童税收抵免。

sentences.en: More recently, though,
sentences.zh: 不过最近，

sentences.en: Republicans have been more willing to do that, realizing that if they want to address some of their priorities, like banning abortions and increasing fertility,
sentences.zh: 共和党人也更愿意这样做了，他们意识到如果他们想解决一些优先事项，比如禁止堕胎和提高生育率，

sentences.en: that working families might need some help.
sentences.zh: 那么工薪家庭可能需要一些帮助。

sentences.en: And this policy is one way that they thought they could do that.
sentences.zh: 而这项政策是他们认为可以做到这一点的一种方式。

sentences.en: It seems like what you're saying is both parties have stated this focus on helping working families.
sentences.zh: 看来你的意思是，两党都表达了对帮助工薪家庭的关注。

sentences.en: Two different ways of actually doing that.
sentences.zh: 只是实现这一目标的两种不同方式。

sentences.en: But recently, we are seeing both parties coalesce around one similar idea, these Trump accounts.
sentences.zh: 但最近，我们看到两党都在围绕一个相似的想法达成共识，即这些“特朗普账户”。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: Now, how did this idea then get on the president's radar?
sentences.zh: 那么，这个想法是如何进入总统视野的呢？

sentences.en: So, there are people on the right who have been loudly advocating for accounts like these.
sentences.zh: 在右翼阵营中，有人一直在大声疾呼支持这类账户。

sentences.en: And they got the Trump administration's ear during the writing of the tax bill.
sentences.zh: 他们在税收法案起草过程中引起了特朗普政府的注意。

sentences.en: There's a group called Invest America that had this idea.
sentences.zh: 有一个叫“投资美国”的组织提出了这个想法。

sentences.en: And from what I understand, it appealed to people in the administration for two main reasons.
sentences.zh: 据我了解，它吸引政府官员主要有两个原因。

sentences.en: One is that it relies on the free markets to grow money for Americans.
sentences.zh: 一是它依靠自由市场为美国人增加财富。

sentences.en: Instead of just government handouts, though babies born in his second term do get the $1,000, it's mostly about the compounding returns from the stock market
sentences.zh: 而不是仅仅依靠政府救济，尽管他第二任期内出生的婴儿确实能得到1000美元，但它主要依靠股市的复利回报，

sentences.en: instead of using taxpayer money to support families and children.
sentences.zh: 而不是使用纳税人的钱来支持家庭和儿童。

sentences.en: A second reason is that it gives people choice on how they spend the money.
sentences.zh: 第二个原因是它让人们在如何花钱上有选择权。

sentences.en: Republicans have generally been opposed to family policies that only provide for one way of caring for children.
sentences.zh: 共和党人通常反对那些只提供一种照顾儿童方式的家庭政策。

sentences.en: For example, subsidized child care, which some worry encourages parents to work outside the home.
sentences.zh: 例如，补贴托儿服务，有些人担心这会鼓励父母在家庭之外工作。

sentences.en: Instead, they prefer policies that provide choice.
sentences.zh: 相反，他们更喜欢提供选择的政策。

sentences.en: Basically, giving families money so that they can choose for themselves and their children how they spend it.
sentences.zh: 基本上，给家庭钱，让他们可以为自己和孩子选择如何花钱。

sentences.en: Okay, Claire, you started to get into this, but what is the idea exactly?
sentences.zh: 好的，克莱尔，你已经开始谈论这个了，但这个想法到底是什么？

sentences.en: What are these accounts?
sentences.zh: 这些账户是什么？

sentences.en: What's the process for it?
sentences.zh: 它的流程是什么？

sentences.en: So anyone under 18 can have an account opened in their name.
sentences.zh: 任何18岁以下的人都可以以自己的名义开立账户。

sentences.en: The law says that the money must be invested in low-cost index funds, which basically means that for minimal fees, they're accessing the broad stock market.
sentences.zh: 法律规定，资金必须投资于低成本指数基金，这意味着他们以极低的费用进入了广阔的股市。

sentences.en: If children are born since January 1st, 2025, and they have an account open in their name, they'll automatically get the $1,000 from the federal government.
sentences.zh: 如果孩子是2025年1月1日之后出生的，并且以他们的名义开立了账户，他们将自动从联邦政府获得1000美元。

sentences.en: And families, friends, employers can donate.
sentences.zh: 家庭、朋友、雇主都可以捐款。

sentences.en: Also, philanthropists can.
sentences.zh: 慈善家也可以。

sentences.en: So the Dells behind the Dell computer fortune have donated $250 to most children who aren't eligible for that $1,000 from the federal government to try to cede these accounts.
sentences.zh: 所以戴尔电脑财富背后的戴尔家族已经向大多数没有资格从联邦政府获得那1000美元的孩子捐赠了250美元，试图为这些账户提供种子资金。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And parents could have checked a box on their tax forms in April to open these accounts, or they can go to irs.gov and get a tax form.
sentences.zh: 父母可以在四月份的税表上勾选一个方框来开设这些账户，或者他们可以去irs.gov获取税表。

sentences.en: And a new thing is that when parents of newborns register for their social security number at the hospital, they will also get a chance to open a Trump account for their baby.
sentences.zh: 还有一个新举措是，当新生儿父母在医院登记社会安全号码时，他们也将有机会为孩子开设一个特朗普账户。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: When the child is 18, they then become an IRA, which is essentially an account that can only be used for certain purposes.
sentences.zh: 当孩子18岁时，它就变成了一个IRA（个人退休账户），这本质上是一个只能用于特定目的的账户。

sentences.en: Retirement, college, buying a first home, things like that.
sentences.zh: 退休、大学、购买第一套住房，诸如此类。

sentences.en: If someone tries to withdraw money from the account for a different purpose, they're assessed a penalty.
sentences.zh: 如果有人试图将钱从账户中取出用于其他目的，他们会被处以罚款。

sentences.en: Fascinating.
sentences.zh: 太迷人了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, Claire, you mentioned that in part, one goal of this is to address the wealth gap, right?
sentences.zh: 那么，克莱尔，你提到在某种程度上，这个目标之一是解决贫富差距，对吧？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I just want to take a step back here.
sentences.zh: 我想退后一步。

sentences.en: What exactly is the difference between the wealth gap and the income gap?
sentences.zh: 贫富差距和收入差距到底有什么区别？

sentences.en: So we've heard a lot about income inequality in the United States, which is the vast difference between what the lowest-paid workers earn each year
sentences.zh: 我们听过很多关于美国收入不平等的问题，这是指收入最低的工人和

sentences.en: and what the highest-paid workers like CEOs and billionaires earn.
sentences.zh: 收入最高的工人（如CEO和亿万富翁）每年赚取的收入之间的巨大差异。

sentences.en: That's about how much you earn from your job.
sentences.zh: 这关乎你从工作中赚多少钱。

sentences.en: But wealth refers to savings and assets.
sentences.zh: 但财富指的是储蓄和资产。

sentences.en: These are like retirement accounts, a brokerage account with your savings in it, the house that you own.
sentences.zh: 这些就像退休账户、存有你积蓄的经纪账户、你拥有的房子。

sentences.en: So the gap between the least wealthy Americans and the most wealthy Americans is even larger than the gap in how much they earn.
sentences.zh: 所以最不富裕的美国人和最富裕的美国人之间的差距，比他们赚多少钱的差距还要大。

sentences.en: Right, right.
sentences.zh: 没错，没错。

sentences.en: Your wealth is basically your net worth, which would cover your long-term savings rather than just what you would earn in a given year.
sentences.zh: 你的财富基本上就是你的净资产，它涵盖了你的长期储蓄，而不仅仅是你一年赚的钱。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And this matters for things like eventually retiring or paying for college, but it also matters in an important day-to-day way because having these kind of savings
sentences.zh: 这对于最终退休或支付大学费用等事情很重要，但它在日常生活中也很重要，因为拥有这种储蓄

sentences.en: provides a buffer.
sentences.zh: 提供了一个缓冲。

sentences.en: If your car breaks down, if you have an unexpected health care expense and you have no savings, that's an incredible stress for your family that can plunge you into poverty.
sentences.zh: 如果你的车坏了，如果你有意外的医疗费用，而你没有储蓄，这对你的家庭来说是一个巨大的压力，可能会让你陷入贫困。

sentences.en: And research has found that even just knowing that a family has some savings like that can decrease the stress in the family even when there's not a financial emergency.
sentences.zh: 研究发现，即使只是知道家庭有这样的储蓄，也能减轻家庭的压力，即使没有财务紧急情况。

sentences.en: I hear you on that.
sentences.zh: 我明白你的意思。

sentences.en: We're talking about this being a buffer, right?
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的是这是一个缓冲，对吧？

sentences.en: But I can't help but think now that also this piece of legislation was criticized for also cutting the social safety net.
sentences.zh: 但我忍不住想到，这项立法也因削减社会安全网而受到批评。

sentences.en: Cutting programs that many of the needy relied on like food stamps.
sentences.zh: 削减了许多贫困人口依赖的项目，比如食品券。

sentences.en: So I can imagine some folks looking at the cost of this program and asking, well, wait, why not get immediate cash here?
sentences.zh: 所以我可以想象有些人看着这个项目的成本会问，等等，为什么不直接给现金呢？

sentences.en: Like what good is sort of an investment in a long-term plan to address the wealth gap when I've got bills to pay right now?
sentences.zh: 比如，当我还有账单要付的时候，这种长期解决贫富差距的投资计划有什么用？

sentences.en: So is this which is more long-term a solution?
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个更长期的解决方案吗？

sentences.en: What's the argument for that?
